# Seyyed Arad Hosseini Moghaddam

AI Engineer and Data Scientist focused on deep learning and machine learning for medical applications, especially medical imaging. A second research direction applies statistics and data science to humanities-related datasets. The broader portfolio includes Persian NLP, language models, LLM fine-tuning, RAG, agentic AI, software engineering, and Flutter development.

## Primary pages
- [Research profile](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/research/): Research interests, documented project evidence, methods, and limitations for academic review and prospective graduate study.
- [Projects](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/): Public projects across medical AI, Persian language modeling, NLP, RAG, agentic AI, datasets, and software.
- [Skills and tools](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/skills/): Full categorized skill inventory generated from the portfolio CV knowledge base.

## Flagship work
- [Persian GPT — 110M transformer from scratch](https://huggingface.co/aradmanamnaoon/persian-lm-from-scratch): Persian corpus preparation, custom tokenizer, transformer training, baselines, and held-out evaluation.
- [3D Cardiac MRI Segmentation](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/medical-image-segmentation): PyTorch, MONAI, 3D U-Net, benchmark validation, and documented clinical limitations.
- [AI Research Assistant Platform](https://github.com/aradmanamnaoon/ai-research-assistant-platform): LangGraph multi-agent workflow, RAG, persistence, citations, streaming, and offline tests.

## Areas of work
- Deep learning, machine learning, medical imaging, and 3D image segmentation.
- Statistics, exploratory analysis, and data science for humanities-related datasets.
- Python, SQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, MONAI, Hugging Face, Transformers, PEFT, LoRA, and QLoRA.
- NLP, Persian language modeling, machine translation, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and MCP.
- FastAPI, Docker, MLflow, Git, GitHub Actions, web development, Django, PyQt6, and Flutter for Android and iOS.
